description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the CandidateStatusAPI in the Recruitment API of the OrangeHRM system. It tests functionalities such as retrieving all candidate statuses and checks that create, delete, and validation rule methods are not implemented.

classes.name: CandidateStatusAPITest
classes.description: Test class for the CandidateStatusAPI, including tests for retrieving all candidate statuses and verifying unimplemented methods.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all candidate statuses via the API endpoint.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases data for the 'testGetAll' method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Confirms that the create method is not implemented and raises the appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule for create is not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the delete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rule for delete is not implemented.
